expo: PINNED TO SDK 54 ON PURPOSE — do not upgrade without reading CLAUDE.md.
Expo Go on the App Store and Play Store is frozen at SDK 54 because Apple has not
approved a newer build. SDK 55+ can only run on a real iPhone via `eas go`, which
needs a paid Apple Developer membership. SDK 54 is what the founder's phone can
actually install, so the app targets it. This only constrains Expo Go development;
a production build via EAS is not limited by this.
overrides: uuid: patches a vulnerable transitive dep of the iOS prebuild tooling (dev-only).
postcss: patches a vulnerable transitive dep of the Metro bundler (dev-only).
Both keep `npm audit` at 0 vulnerabilities without downgrading Expo.
